acceptance: Probe mode cannot upload to TestPyPI or PyPI, create attestations, or push tags or releases: asserted by test (no publish-action or attest step executes when probe=true; id-token permission absent in probe)
The #3947 graph (before #3956) kept as a fixture turns red in probe through the rv2r-06 detector (2)
Probe runs in under 15 minutes and holds at most 4 runners
A PR touching release-v2.yml shows the probe job; making it a required check is prepared as a settings change for the owner (DECISION GATE)
Both evidence variants (reuse and fallback) execute in probe and reach the publish dry run
context:
Member of batch release-v2-remediation. GUARDRAILS: probe must be structurally incapable of publishing (no id-token: write, no upload step); never route probe through the pypi or test-pypi environments. DECISION GATE: making the probe job a required status check is a repository-settings change; prepare it and ask the owner.

2026-11-06 leader: removed rv2r-06 (already landed on the integration branch) from needs. Ordinary needs are done-only, and batch members reach done only at batch finish, so a same-batch ordinary need would deadlock the batch; the ordering is guaranteed by the integration branch instead.
description: The #3947 publish-skip bug passed unit tests (one asserted the broken shape) and local and hosted oracle review, and was found only by a 3-hour live run. Add a probe mode: release-v2 runs with its real job graph and conditions, but admit uses a synthetic probe target (no tag ruleset needed); install-matrix runs one Linux py3.12 cell; UAT shards are stubs that emit valid evidence for the stub digest; the evidence-check path (rv2r-03) is exercised in both reuse and fallback variants; and publish runs as a dry run (download admitted files, verify SHA256SUMS, twine check; no upload, no attestation). All other jobs keep their real needs and if. A PR-triggered job runs probe mode whenever .github/workflows/release-v2.yml, .github/workflows/trunk-uat.yml, .github/workflows/trunk.yml (dist-artifact job), scripts/release_*.py or the release-uat-env action change. Rollback: revert this member's commits.
